scenario.topic: Pick a note-taking system for a joint research project

options.name: Microsoft OneNote
options.upside: Supports rich media notes and seamless syncing across devices.
options.concern: Interface can be complex for new users.

options.name: Evernote
options.upside: Organizes notes with tags and powerful search features.
options.concern: Free version limits monthly upload size.

options.name: Google Keep
options.upside: Simple interface with quick note creation and reminders.
options.concern: Limited organization features compared to other apps.

options.name: Notion
options.upside: Highly customizable workspace combining notes and project management.
options.concern: Steeper learning curve for advanced features.

shared_context: Two researchers need to select a note-taking system for their joint project. The system must support text and image notes, allow easy sharing, and work on both Windows and mobile devices.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a 34-year-old researcher who values customizable tools for managing complex projects.
personas.private_goal: To use a note-taking system that integrates notes and project management seamlessly.

A.reason_for: Supports rich media notes and syncing across devices, meeting basic needs.
A.reason_against: Interface can be complex, which might slow down workflow.

B.reason_for: Good organization with tags and search, useful for research notes.
B.reason_against: Limited free uploads could be restrictive over time.

C.reason_for: Simple and quick note-taking with real-time collaboration.
C.reason_against: Limited organization features make it less suitable for complex projects.

D.reason_for: Highly customizable workspace combining notes and project management, ideal for joint research.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a 40-year-old researcher who prefers straightforward and efficient tools with strong collaboration features.
personas.private_goal: To have a note-taking system that is easy to use and supports real-time collaboration without complexity.

A.reason_for: Supports rich media notes and real-time collaboration with seamless syncing on Windows and mobile.

B.reason_for: Offers shared notebooks with permissions and powerful search features.
B.reason_against: Free tier limits uploads, which could hinder extensive note-taking.

C.reason_against: Lacks Windows desktop app and has limited organization features.

D.reason_for: Real-time collaboration and customization are beneficial.
D.reason_against: Steeper learning curve and complexity may reduce efficiency.
